items.reason: Inclusion for "Recurrent glioblastoma (Group 3 dose escalation and expansion)" requires "[68Ga]Ga-DOTA-TATE uptake by positron emission tomography/computed tomography (PET/CT) or PET/MRI at the tumor region"; D30-R2 counts imaging-assessed target expression with a matched radioligand as candidate-matched selection. It applies to one arm only, so enrichment.

The uptake criterion is listed only under Group 3 criteria; Group 1 (newly diagnosed) has no uptake requirement, so it is an arm-level requirement (enrichment), not a whole-trial eligibility criterion. Either role yields candidate_matched_selection true.

note: Positive candidate_matched decision: falls under D21 human review and is excluded in the D30-R2 imaging-assessed sensitivity analysis. Radiopharmaceutical; moiety name may be normalised to oxodotreotide by the mapping script.
